blocks.content: The Lokpal shall have powers of superintendence over, and direction to, any investigating agency including the Delhi Special Police Establishment in respect of the cases referred by it.

rows: Determine if a prima facie case exists
Inquiry Wing of Lokpal or any agency
Investigating agency (e.g., CBI) under Lokpal supervision

items: Inquiries against the Prime Minister cannot be initiated if allegations relate to international relations, security, public order, atomic energy, or space.
Prior sanction from the government is NOT required for the Lokpal to initiate an inquiry or direct prosecution against a public servant.
A preliminary inquiry by the Lokpal must ordinarily be completed within 60 days, extendable by another 60 days for valid reasons.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Lokpal has jurisdiction to inquire into allegations of corruption against the Prime Minister, Union Ministers, Members of Parliament, and Group A, B, C, and D officers.
It possesses the statutory powers of a Civil Court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, including summoning witnesses and demanding document production.
The Lokpal exercises powers of superintendence and direction over any investigating agency, including the CBI, for cases referred by it.
It has the authority to order search and seizure operations as well as the provisional attachment of assets acquired through corrupt means.
